title: Briakos thesis reproducibility-materials public-access audit

thesis_identity.author: Nikolaos Briakos
thesis_identity.title: An Undeciphered Script in the Age of AI: A Corpus-Constrained Computational Analysis of Linear A
thesis_identity.institution: University of Piraeus, Department of Informatics

statements_inside_thesis.statement_summary: The methodology section states that all datasets compiled and code developed for training the models are made available openly and that code and models are released for replication.
The transformer section states that trained model weights and full training history were archived as supplementary materials to the thesis.
The contributions section states that all code, data, and provenance records are preserved in a complete reproducible pipeline with SHA256-linked sources.

queries: University of Piraeus item full record
public_discovery_search.note: No public code/model repository was confirmed by the searches performed in this audit. Absence from these searches is not proof that no separate archive exists.

reproducibility_consequence.recommended_next_route: Search for institutional supplementary-object endpoints or obtain the archived code/materials from the author/institution; meanwhile test externally fixed parser families only as clearly labelled same-lineage hypotheses.

epistemic_note: This audit records public discoverability at the stated time. It does not assert that the author failed to create, archive, or privately deposit the claimed materials.
